name: Dong 73: Yang Hongse Tonghua
source:
A mundane daily life drama,
Familiar and nostalgic scenery.
Xiao Su, an ordinary art college applicant, possesses an extraordinary ability—he can see the "scenery" in people’s hearts.
Before the start of his senior year, Xiao Su is transferred by his father to an art class in Middle School No.33. There, he reunites with his elementary school classmate and now fellow classmate again, Chen Kongling.
Despite the reunion, Xiao Su doesn't feel much nostalgia for Kongling. On this day, in the art classroom, Xiao Su meets his classmate Xia Chuhe and her close friend, Ye Siyan.
To Xiao Su's surprise, he discovers that Ye Siyan, though small in stature, shares his ability to peer into others' hearts.
Thus begins the tense life of senior year, as students challenge their monthly exam scores in a bid to participate in the last sports meet of high school.
And so, the story begins.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/769550/East_73_Magenta_Fairytale/]steam[/url]]
translation:
一部平凡的日常生活剧，
熟悉又怀旧的风景。
小苏，一名普通的艺术院校申请者，却拥有一种非凡的能力——他能看到人们心中的“风景”。
高三开学前，小苏被父亲转学到33中美术班。在那里，他与小学同学、现在又是同班同学的陈孔令重逢。
尽管重逢，小苏却对空灵并没有太多的留恋之情。这一天，在美术教室里，小苏遇见了同学夏楚河和她的好朋友叶思言。
让小苏惊讶的是，他发现叶思言虽然身材矮小，却有着看透别人内心的能力。
紧张的高三生活就这样开始了，学生们挑战每月的考试成绩，争取参加高中最后一次运动会。
于是，故事开始了。
